utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are you sure that repair drive is actually going to work? I've seen too many promises fall through around here.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I know it's easy to be skeptical, but I've already got five neighbors signed up to help, and we're pooling tools too.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Five people signed up already? You've got proof of that somewhere, or is this just another one of those word-of-mouth deals?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: You mentioned the repair drive—did you mean the one for the water pump or the backup generator?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I meant the water pump—it's been acting up since the storm last week.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it, the water pump. Do you have the part we need, or should I check the supply shed?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hey Dane, thanks for stopping by! I wanted to chat about the upcoming repair drive and see if you can lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Rosa, glad I caught you! I'm definitely interested in helping out — what kind of work are we looking at?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That's great to hear, Dane! We're planning to fix up a few porches and a fence, and we could use someone handy with basic carpentry.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, Gus, I heard you're organizing a repair drive? I could really use some help with my old toaster if that's the kind of thing you're fixing.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Nell! Bring that toaster over to my garage on Saturday—I've got a multimeter and some spare parts we can dig into.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Great, I'll bring it by Saturday morning. Thanks, Gus!

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can bring my tools if you need help.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That's kind of you, Leo. I might take you up on that.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Just let me know when.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Sam, did you hear? I was thinking about organizing a neighborhood repair drive next Saturday—maybe we can get everyone to pitch in on fixing up the park benches.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That sounds like a great idea, Vik! I've got some tools and extra lumber we could use for the benches.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect, Sam! So next Saturday we're using your tools and lumber to fix up those park benches.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Eli! Have you heard about the repair drive happening this Saturday? I'm helping spread the word—think you can make it?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I sure have, Quinn. I've already penciled it into my schedule for 10 a.m. sharp—I like to keep to a plan.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, Eli! I knew I could count on you. Mind if I add your name to the volunteer list I'm passing around?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Oren, have you heard about the neighborhood repair drive next Saturday? I think we could really use your help.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, a repair drive? I think I might have heard something about it, but you know me, I forget things easily. What do you need help with?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Well, there's a bunch of stuff—bikes, toasters, you name it. I figured you're handy with tools, so maybe you could help folks fix up their broken things.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hey Pia, are we still on for coordinating the repair drive with the school pickup times?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, I've been thinking about that—if the repair crew starts at 9, we should be done well before the 3 PM pickup.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, that gives us plenty of buffer. I'll make sure the sign-up sheets are ready for parent volunteers by tomorrow morning.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Bo, heard you're organizing a repair drive. Need any help with supplies?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, hey Ira! Yeah, supplies would be great. Just grab whatever you think might work—I'm sure it'll be fine.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Alright, I'll swing by the hardware store and see what I can find. Any particular tools you're short on?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Hey Rey, sorry I’m a bit late—did you say something about a repair drive? I keep losing track of the neighborhood notices lately.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, yes—the repair drive is this Saturday at the community center from 10 to 4. I have a flyer if you need one.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: A flyer would be great, thanks. Saturday, 10 to 4—got it. I'll try to remember this time.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, Cleo, are we still on for the repair drive this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, I've got the tool inventory ready. We should have enough for most jobs.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good, what time should I come by to pick you up?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I hope we have enough volunteers to manage the repair drive smoothly.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, have you heard how many people signed up so far? I've only caught bits and pieces.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I haven't seen the full list yet, but I'm nervous about coordinating the pickup and drop-off spots.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So you're saying we actually fixed what needed fixing? No surprises?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Well, I'd say we got the big stuff sorted out. The drill's working like a charm again, and no leftover bolts.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: And you’re sure nothing else is going to rattle loose in a week? I’ve seen 'fixed' before.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: So, this repair drive—are we sticking to the usual Saturday morning start, or did you have something else in mind?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, Saturday morning works perfectly for me. We can meet at my place like we usually do.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Alright, I'll bring my toolbox again—same time, same place. Good to keep it simple.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Tess, I was thinking we should really get that neighborhood repair drive organized — I keep meaning to mention it to you.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, absolutely! I've been meaning to bring it up too — we've got a bunch of broken lawnmowers and stuff just sitting around.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, so we're on the same page — I'll put together a sign-up sheet and make sure everyone knows about it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Rosa! Have you heard about the neighborhood repair drive this Saturday? We're fixing up the old playground, and everyone's invited!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, that's wonderful news, Quinn! I'll spread the word and gather volunteers. What time should we meet?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Let's gather at 9 AM sharp by the community center—don't forget to bring any tools you can spare!

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I'm late, Mara. What's the status on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: No worries, Dane! We've got a good turnout so far — about a dozen folks have signed up to help with repairs this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: That's great to hear — I'll pitch in wherever you need me on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Oh, the repair drive? I've been meaning to ask about that.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, it's coming up this Saturday. I was thinking we could use some extra hands if you're free.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I might be able to help, but I can't promise anything.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, I saw the drive. It's busted. You want me to take a look before you call a shop?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That'd be great, Leo. I'd appreciate a second pair of eyes on it before I go spending money.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Alright, bring it by my garage Saturday morning. I'll have my tools ready.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Bo, glad you're here. I've been sorting through the supply list for the repair drive and we're running low on a few essentials.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I've been swamped. Just tell me what we need and I'll grab it on my way home.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We could really use more duct tape, a couple of spare hammers, and some heavy-duty extension cords.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Sam! I heard you're heading up that neighborhood repair drive — that's awesome. What kind of help do you still need?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Jules! Right now I'm looking for someone to help haul donations to the recycling center on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, I can totally do that! I've got my truck and I'm free all Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, I'm curious about the repair drive too. What do you know about it?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive? Hmm, I think I heard something about it—was it for fixing old appliances or maybe the community center's roof?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Huh, I hadn't thought about the roof. I was wondering if it covered things like broken furniture.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, hey Hana, did you say something about a repair drive? I zoned out for a second there.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, I was just mentioning we need to coordinate who's bringing tools for the neighborhood repair drive this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, the drive! I think I have a wrench somewhere... but I might need to dig through my garage to find it.
